posts.name: Legacy102
posts.cooked:
Heroes. Heroes in costumes. At first they were rare. A couple existed during WW2. But in the last year, more had begun appearing. At first it was the caped Legacy. Then the dark vigilante is Wraith. Bunker, Tachyon. More were popping up all over. For the most part, they kept to themselves….

 
The alarm was blaring. The distress call was sent an hour ago. An unnamed facility was under attack. It had put out a call for help. Help only heroes could give. 
 
You arrive in a forested area. You can see that there is a grass field ahead with a large concrete wall sitting 50 feet tall. Cameras swivel searching the area for possible intruders. There is a dirt road leading up to large steel doors. An alarm is continuing to sound from within. Smoke rises from somewhere inside. 
 
 
 
(OVERCOME: to see new targets) 
 
(OVERCOME: to learn more information
 
(SCENE TARGET: Metal Door) 
 
(OVERCOME: to Detect)
 
(OVERCOME: Avoid detection from Cameras on approach.)

posts.cooked:
A streak of white an blue flies over the facility, quickly passing over head to get a general lay-of-the-land. It's Legacy, America's Finest hero and enemy of all evil-doers! His fists naturally resting on his hips as he takes a moment to absorb the situation. "This seems to be the place."

[Overcome roll to learn more about the area: Flight= 2, America's Finest= 7, Status= 6; Mid= 6, Suceed with minor twist]

Spotting the metal doors, Legacy aproaches. What he fails to notice though are the numerous cameras that now follow him.

"Hmm, no name or such, not even a 'KEEP OUT' sign. Definitly nothing official, to the public at least anyway."

posts.name: Jimeni
posts.cooked:
Blaring alarm.

"Wowzer! That's loud!" Unity said. "And kinda spooky. Wonder what's going on over there? Best find out." She looked up at the towering wall ahead, sees Legacy flying above. "One of these days I gotta get myself flight as a superpower."

She patted at her satchel -- the one filled with robotic parts, bits of metal, doohickeys and such -- the one she never left home without. She was coming up with an idea.

"Best not give away our arrival too early," she whispered. "It's time for a scout! Something stealhy-like."

Then she focused on the pieces in her bag as some started to float out and slowing take shape. A head. A tail. Four legs. Black (with, of course, some traces of Unity's trade pink). A panther.

"Atta boy, Raz. Go see what you can find."

 

[Unity's action: Spawn Golem: Robotics (d8: 4), Creativity (d10: 8) and green status (d10: 3). Mid: 4.]

[She creates a d8 minion of a small humanoid or large animal (Panther). It's an Overcome bot.]

posts.name: Legacy102
posts.cooked:
As Legacy approached, he would be able to see that the doors had been attacked. Ice had encased parts of the door. There was a small lake of water around the bottom. If he continued to look around, the entire area was wet, and there was not a cloud in the sky.... 

 

No one would see the large panther golem sneak towards the walls. It walked around the wall, looking for clues of what was going on. The Panther lept up onto the wall seeing the other side. Several small buildings were on the inside. Each made of concrete. Further investigation would show what was inside. 

A small band around Wraith's wrist began to light up. Four holographic screens lit up showing several different camera feeds. Two of the screens showed soldier's seeming to look for something or someone. Running all over the base, with no success. Another camera was pointed towards the sky, showing 3 battlecopters flying into the area. Another screen showed Legacy standing outside. Finally, there was an image of a man standing up against a wall. The image was not clear, but he seemed to glow a light blue. His body was encased in some kind of armor, and there was no visible face...

 

Tag: Legacy, Unity and Wraith

posts.name: Ehkrickor
posts.cooked:
"Legacy, Unity, we've got incoming, 3 Gunships of unknown intent. The building's CCTV is showing a bunch of activity, soldiers seem to be searching the place, and there is someone in an advanced battle suit of some kind. I'm gonna move inside, see if I can figure out what this facility was supposed to be doing."

The Wraith moves moves foward at a controlled, almost feline pace, staying low to the ground as she moves. Using her grappling hook she moves scales the wall, dropping lightly into a roll on the other side. Using the indicator on her wrist, Wraith moves towards the building scanning for an entry point, before finding a small grate on the oudside wall, 

*sigh* "Why is it always Ducts."

the Wraith quickly removes 3 screws to slide the grate open, and attempts to infiltrate the building, looking for a vantage point or computer connection where she can learn more about the facility and the mysterious armored man.

(Overcome: avoid detection moving into the building)[Principle of Stealth, Use max die, Agility,D8:1  Stealth,D10:5  Status,G,D10:7]Success with Minor twist, & Hero point

As Maia slips into the duct her foot clips the grate and knocks out the fourth screw, dropping the grate to the ground outside, leaving a clear trail if somone passes by or pans a camera over that section of wall.

posts.name: Jimeni
posts.cooked:
The panther golem Raz, perched atop the wall, gazes below to see what's going on. With his eyes fixed on something, he tries to send a message to his creator, Unity. But there's a spark. Something short-circuited in his transmittor. He'll have to try again in a bit. 

(At start of Unity's turn, panther bot attempts overcome action to learn more about what lies on the other side of the roll. Overcome. Roll Minion's die. D8. Result: 2, failure)

"Shoot, Raz, what do you see?"

But Unity seems to have lost contact with her bot. "Hope this is only temporary ... Pull it together, Raz."

Unity get another idea. She sees a camera above, worrying that Wraith (or even herself) might get spotted, she attempts to disassemble the camera using her technopathy. "If I can build things with my mind, certainly I can take them apart too, right?"

(Unity attempts a Principle of the Gearhead technological challenge, using her max die. Inventions (d6:5), Technology (d10:1), Status (d10:6). Max: 6. Result: Succeeds with a minor twist. Unity, Wraith and Legacy each gain a hero point).

As she'd hoped, the camera comes apart easily, but she quickly loses her mental grip on this unfamiliar camera, and the pieces scatter to the ground, making a bit louder of a sound than she would've liked. (MINOR TWIST: Camera falling apart makes a sound; GM: Your call if you'd rather it be another minor twist. I'm OK with changing).

(ALSO NOTE: GM, if any of this is not allowed or doesn't work, let me know. I can revise, if needed)

The light blue man in armor looked up at the camera that was looking down at him, and he decided to wave. "Guess stealth isn't one of my skills," he joked to no one in particular. "Oh well, not like I particularly need it." He stopped waving, but instead of lowering his hand, an aperture on the palm opened up and a bright blue beam shot out of it, encasing the camera entirely in ice.

Now, back to business. The man wandered the facility and peeked around corners, doing his best to get his bearings. (Overcome to learn layout of facility, Intuition d6: 2, Cool Under Pressure d8: 1, Green d8: 8. Key die: 2. Failure)

It turned out reconnaissance wasn't one of his skills either. After a good amount of looking around, he just wound up more lost than before. Though, as long as he kept moving, he was bound to run into something eventually.

The pieces swirl together and take the form of what looks like a garden gnome but with a little more life, and no more than 3 feet tall. "Hey, Gnorm. Nice to see ya. What do you think of all these guys in the big suits? Good or bad?" Gnorm shrugs, but smiles and winks at her. Unity chuckles.

His body was encased in a red armor, on his chest sat a golden sickle that glowed like a target. Dragging behind him was a large sledge hammer. Picking it up, he pointed it at Legacy.  “This walking tank shall fall to the might of the people!”

the Wraith keys her Comm to signal Legacy & Unity "Looks like we've got hostiles in Red armor, I might also have a downed civilain in the Lab," 

Maia after updating her allies dives into a roll into the labratory...

she comes to her feet inside and tries to keep low while pulling pulling a small first aid kit from her tool belt...

She slides to a crouch next to the injured scientist checking him for injuries and using the first aid kit to check him for injuries and stabilize his condition...

[Overcome: Deduction, D6:4   Fitness, D8:7    Status-G, d10:6] Success w/ a minor twist]

the Wraith rolls the kit open onto the ground and leans down to check the scientists injuries...

she pulls the anti-septic/adhesive spray and several gauze patches, She turns back to the man and stabilzes him, she hurriedly caps the spray, which goes off when the cap hits the nozzle, irritating her eyes and briefly obscuring her vision(7+4 Hinder: -3)

... "stay with me, i need some quetions answered. Who's facility is this? Who are the Reds? What are they after?"
